text: Stepping through this corridor and looking into a mostly empty meeting room, I feel a quiet anticipation. The faint hum of overhead lights merges with the sterile, orderly arrangement within—a space preparing for discourse. Then, upon entering the vibrant, idea-filled exhibit, my mind stirs with curiosity and intrigue. The interplay of innovation and knowledge surrounds me, urging me to question, to reflect. Being here, I sense the pulse of human thought, both in solitude and in collectivity—a reminder of how we seek meaning through reason and creativity.
